sources.title: Inbound Marketing: Get Found Using Google, Social Media, and Blogs
Google users are less likely to click on links when an AI summary appears in the results

concepts.definition: Creating and distributing valuable, relevant content for a defined audience to support a business goal.
Channels a company controls, such as its website and email list.
The stages from awareness to decision, retention and advocacy, each needing different content.

questions.q: Why does content marketing aim to move an audience to owned media?
questions.a: Because platforms can change rules and reach, while an owned channel such as an email list stays reachable.

questions.q: In the 2025 Pew analysis, how often did users click a result link with and without an AI summary?
questions.a: On 8% of visits with an AI summary and on 15% without one.

questions.q: Name one piece of content for each journey stage for a tea shop.
questions.a: Awareness: why green tea is bitter; consideration: sencha vs matcha; decision: tasting set page; retention: monthly tea email; advocacy: gift guide.
